An independent SymPy exact polynomial expansion and simplex beta integration recomputed every coefficient for powers one, two and three, proving the displayed e1,e2,e3 identities. Their nonzero -e3/756 coefficient gives exact inversion; positive cubic roots plus 4e2>e1² are the necessary/sufficient Heron feasibility condition. The two explicit distinct positive-area side-square triples have e1=6,e2=11 but different e3. The area formula and strict bounds follow from Newton inequalities and positive Heron area.
